profile.name: Miguel Angel Gutierrez Maya

headline.lead: I build digital products that feel

profile.introduction: Product Engineer & Mobile with 7 years building web platforms, backend services and cross-platform apps. I turn open-ended product challenges into fast, maintainable systems — from polished interfaces to serverless services and offline-ready mobile flows.

capabilities.title: One product mindset, across the entire stack.
capabilities.description: I connect interaction design, software architecture and business context to ship experiences that are easier to use and maintain.

projects.title: Products built for conversations, operations and everyday decisions.
projects.description: Explore production platforms and hands-on studies spanning modern frontend, serverless backend and cross-platform mobile engineering.

experience.title: A career built close to users, teams and production.
experience.description: From workforce operations and fintech workflows to AI-centered communication products, each role expanded my product ownership, technical leadership and production impact.

skills.title: Tools change. Strong engineering principles travel.
skills.description: A broad toolkit applied with clean boundaries, measurable performance and maintainable delivery practices.

experiences.role: Fullstack & mobile developer · Frontend team lead
experiences.summary: Led a five-person frontend team and helped evolve real-time AI conversation products across web and Flutter — introducing hexagonal boundaries, modular React frontends and measurable Core Web Vitals gains.
Shipped event-driven microservices and production integrations for an education platform serving 500+ schools, improving reliability through RabbitMQ workflows and focused incident response.
Owned discovery-to-deployment delivery for 8+ custom web and mobile products, building REST APIs and operational dashboards that halved time spent processing business data.
Turned client requirements into production-ready applications and supported adoption through documentation, on-site training and hands-on rollout.
Expanded a live travel platform with booking and operations modules, resolving production defects and translating business feedback into adopted usability improvements.
